mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and hepatotoxicity, potentially impairing hepatic synthesis of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors, which may be further compromised if vitamin K supplementation is inadequate or if there is underlying liver dysfunction.
action: Monitor INR/PT regularly in patients receiving propylthiouracil, ensure adequate vitamin K intake, and assess liver function periodically; coordinate with anticoagulation management if applicable.
